goal: Cut the cost of getblocktemplate longpolling by tracking mempool fee inflow instead of rebuilding a full block template on every tick
Centralize mining template creation, submission, and staleness logic behind a single manager to simplify internal callers
reviewability: Review #35675 first, since this PR is a superset carrying that refactor plus new fee-inflow tracking commits
The new commits are ready to review now and nothing known would invalidate reviewing them, author is active with recent force-pushes
agreement: Strong support with concept ACKs and no unresolved objections

Praised as a clean design that moves free functions into stateful class with incremental tracking (pablomartin4btc)
Plain concept ACK without detailed reasoning (w0xlt)

categories.name: ipc
